description: IFRS 18 transition map of a chart of accounts (EARLY ADOPTER: IFRS 18 effective 2027-01-01). FREE — no credit charged. Input: accounts (the chart, each account named in the general journal's vocabulary — a name outside it is refused with the closest names), isGroup, and the facts the categories turn on: entityFacts and, for a group, groupFacts (ifrs18SpecifiedMainBusinessActivities, ifrs18MainBusinessEvidence, financeProviderUnrelatedLiabilitiesCategory). Returns, per account, its IFRS 18 category (OPERATING, INVESTING, FINANCING, INCOME_TAX, DISCONTINUED; IFRS 18.47) in the entity's own statements (individual) and in the group's (group), each with its paragraph — the same category the engine gives the account's lines when it posts them. SPLIT: the account holds lines of more than one category, and split.decidedBy names what decides each line (a finance provider's liabilityRelationToCustomerFinancing, IFRS 18.65-66; or the asset or liability each line comes from, stated where the line is posted, IFRS 18.47). DEPENDS_ON: the category turns on a fact not stated — dependsOn names it, and factsToState lists every such fact with the accounts it decides; nothing is assumed. NOT_PROFIT_OR_LOSS: a statement of financial position or OCI account. Read-only planning: no calculation, no journal entry.

accounts.description: Required. An array of 1 to 500 account names, one per account of the chart of accounts, each a name of the general journal's vocabulary (ifr_schema({ standard: "general-journal" }) lists them in accountMap). A name outside it is refused with the closest names.

entityFacts.description: OPTIONAL, an object: the entity's own facts the categories turn on — ifrs18SpecifiedMainBusinessActivities ([{ activity }], [] for none; IFRS 18.49, B30-B36), ifrs18MainBusinessEvidence (B33-B36), financeProviderUnrelatedLiabilitiesCategory (OPERATING or FINANCING; IFRS 18.65(a)(ii)). A fact not stated is never assumed: an account turning on it answers DEPENDS_ON naming it. EARLY ADOPTER: IFRS 18 effective 2027-01-01.

groupFacts.description: OPTIONAL, an object, read only when isGroup is true: the same facts for the consolidated group, assessed for the reporting entity as a whole (IFRS 18.B37). EARLY ADOPTER: IFRS 18 effective 2027-01-01.

isGroup.description: Required, true or false. true: the entity is a parent presenting consolidated statements, and each account is also mapped in the group view (IFRS 18.B37).

name: ifr_ifrs18_transition_map
